note: Safe sample inputs for the lab. No real credentials, no personal data and no material taken from any live system. The adverse samples are deliberately weak configurations used to prove that the engine raises the correct warning.

safe.label: Short classroom message
safe.text: MEET AT THE LIBRARY AT NOON
safe.expectation: Completed with a warning that the Caesar cipher is not confidential.

safe.label: Authenticated encryption round trip
safe.text: Attendance sheet for lab session four.
safe.expectation: Completed. Original accepted, tampered copy rejected.

safe.label: Key derivation at the configured minimum
Avalanche measurement on ordinary text
safe.expectation: Average changed bits inside the configured band.

safe.label: Vigenere with an adequate keyword
safe.expectation: Completed with a warning that Vigenere is still a classical cipher.

adverse.label: Key derivation at a negligible cost
adverse.expectation: Critical. The engine must name the iteration threshold, not report only that the setting is unsafe.

adverse.label: Nonce reused across two messages
adverse.expectation: Critical. The second message must be recovered exactly from the first.

adverse.label: Caesar shift that performs no encryption
adverse.expectation: Critical. Output equals input, so no confidentiality is applied at all.

adverse.label: Vigenere keyword too short to resist analysis
adverse.text: THE QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS OVER THE LAZY DOG
adverse.expectation: Warning naming the configured minimum keyword length.

adverse.label: Caesar ciphertext recovered without the key
adverse.text: WKH WUHDVXUH LV EXULHG XQGHU WKH ROG RDN WUHH
adverse.expectation: Critical. The engine recovers shift 3 and the readable plaintext using letter frequencies alone.

malformed.label: Nonce reuse messages of different lengths
Iteration count above the laptop safety ceiling
